license_evidence.scope: KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev weights published in Kwaipilot's Hugging Face repository under the Apache 2.0 licence declared by the model card

access_boundary: This record represents the KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev open-weight checkpoint. The API-only flagship KAT-Coder on StreamLake, the earlier KAT-Dev line, the base Qwen3.6-35B-A3B weights, and Kwaipilot's HiPO, OASIS, and SRPO lines are separate boundaries.
strengths: Apache 2.0 open weights on the developer's own organization with vLLM and transformers serving commands in the model card
Agentic coding release with a technical report, benchmark methodology, and 256K context for repository-scale work
tradeoffs: The card's reference serving setup needs tensor parallelism across 8 GPUs, so running it is data-center-class self-operation
The flagship KAT-Coder stays API-only, so this Dev checkpoint trails it and its relative standing needs the report, not the card
